title: Treaty Integration and Constitutional Compatibility (Monism vs. Dualism)

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Hungary follows a moderate dualist system: international treaties become domestic law only upon formal statutory promulgation (*kihirdetés törvényben vagy kormányrendeletben*).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: In the *jogforrási hierarchia*, promulgated international treaties rank below the Fundamental Law but above ordinary parliamentary Acts: an Act conflicting with an international treaty must be annulled by the Constitutional Court.
